name: Owner Featured: Field Notes v1
status: locked 2026-10-12 (Bob approved the Summer Bill Shock v4 reference)
extends: owner-explainer-field-notes-v1: part 3 is an accepted narrated Field Notes render, reused byte for byte
aspect: 9:16, 1080x1920, 30 fps; every part encoded to the explainer's stream format and joined by stream copy

parts.picture: realistic customer moment: Higgsfield nano_banana_2 keyframe (person reviews it), then kling3_0 5 s from the approved keyframe; nothing printed is legible
parts.audio: owner voiceover, one take, intended pace set at generation
parts.length: about 4 s: voiceover then the reaction held

parts.picture: owner's Argil talking head in the business's approved look (same look as the close)
parts.audio: owner voice, one take; Argil lip-syncs that exact audio

parts.default: NEW topic-specific Field Notes story and animation for every reel (fieldnotes workflow: brief -> validated storyboard -> silent preview -> owner narration), same Field Notes visual style
parts.optional_variant: reuse an earlier accepted narrated Field Notes render unchanged, only when the person explicitly asks for it

parts.source: the business's saved, approved close (clip, audio, overlay layout, final frame); reused unchanged, never regenerated

music.treatment: one continuous bed under all four parts, added last over the assembled reel
music.fade_out: from 0.15 s after the last spoken word to the final frame
music.voices: mixed at their exact level (no normaliser or limiter on speech)
music.checks: speech over bed per word, phone number span, sample peak <= -1 dBFS, joins

default_bed.description: NanoFlow upbeat bed (ElevenLabs Music, 'bright upbeat friendly product launch, 112 bpm'), 66 s
default_bed.approved: Bob, 2026-10-12 at bed_gain_db -14; template default for every business (Bob, 2026-10-23)

music.override: a business profile may set its own music (file, sha256, approval); otherwise default_bed is used

rules: No time-stretching of narration. Set pace at generation (voice speed setting) and review by listening; retime the talking-head video to the audio if timing must change.
No automatic retakes: every paid item (keyframe, animation, voice, Argil) is quoted and approved before generation.
No invented branding, vehicles, contact details, bill amounts or customer details.
Close: logo (with the business name) across the top clear of the face, number large beneath it, both held through the final frame, about 2 s hold after speech, no fade to black.
Business specifics (owner voice, Argil look, logo, number, brand colours, close, optional music override) live in tenants/<slug>.json, never in this format.
assembly: verify every reused file by sha256 before assembly
Argil returns portrait looks pillarboxed in 2560x1440: crop the 808x1438 picture, scale to 1080x1920
new parts: fixed gain to the explainer's loudness (no loudnorm, no limiter); stream-copy the explainer and the close
join by concat stream copy; then add the music bed per 'music'
